$comment: Local IPC only. Carries a salted site key and an optional device-local alias; never uploaded, logged, or included in crash diagnostics. Answered with menu_status carrying correction_acknowledgment, or error_response. Sends nothing about the site anywhere; the menu_status it is answered with may refresh cloud readiness, as any status poll does.
title: SetSiteCategory

payload.description: Teaches Velvt what one site is, on every page and in every browser. Carries no event id and no hostname: the key is the one unclassified_triage reported. Saving the same answer twice is the same as saving it once.

site_stable_id.description: The site key exactly as unclassified_triage reported it for a site entry.

activity_name.description: Device-local name the user typed for the site. Never the hostname: Velvt keeps a hostname only in local_site_name, and deletes it when the site is taught. Never include it in cloud requests, telemetry, logs, or crash diagnostics.
